name: My Consuming Love
source:
Help make decisions for Ritsu throughout his day that will either get him a boyfriend or… well. Multiple bad things can happen.
There are six possible people you can be with: Koga, Mao, Mika, Izumi, Hajime or Eichi. There are six good endings, seven bad endings and one neutral ending.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170322182858/http://in0my0u.tumblr.com:80/post/152580489798/happy-halloween-download-windows-mac-to]Tumblr[/url]]

A fanfic romance visual novel based on [url=/v31681]Ensemble Stars![/url].
translation:
帮助朔间凛月在一天之中做出种种抉择——是顺利收获一位男友，还是…嗯，遭遇接二连三的坏事呢。
共有六名可攻略对象：大神晃牙、衣更真绪、影片美伽、濑名泉、紫之创与天祥院英智。游戏包含六个好结局、七个坏结局以及一个普通结局。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170322182858/http://in0my0u.tumblr.com:80/post/152580489798/happy-halloween-download-windows-mac-to]Tumblr[/url]]

基于《[url=/v31681]偶像梦幻祭[/url]》创作的同人恋爱视觉小说。
